title: Chips and grit at weathered stone edges
notes: The existing WAR_GROUND_PLATES=1 preview now gathers small chips and finer grit beside selected ash-facing slab edges. Their aprons follow the actual built stone instead of scattering independently across the world.

Intact neighbouring slabs, the starter cave walk-out apron, shrine clearing and ruin footprints stay clear. One bounded cosmetic batch leaves the original terrain, solid stone and foliage records intact; switching the preview off restores the ordinary cover.

Close and grazing same-build comparisons isolate the added fragments from the raised tops. The generated cluster shape and missing contact shadows still need judgment; regional exposure, the performance activation gate and Phase 0 art acceptance remain open.
